body:
With this release, delta can be used as a TUI. It's based on a fork of [gitu](https://github.com/altsem/gitu), and has many keybindings for exploring `git diff`, `git show`, and `git log views`, the ability to stage directly from delta-rendered diffs (including side-by-side), reorder and fixup commits in your native log view, diff folding, and all of gitu's other git operations (commit, push, pull, rebase, etc). See the manual https://dandavison.github.io/delta/tui.html and the [README](https://github.com/dandavison/delta/blob/main/README.md#tui-mode) for documentation and videos. Many thanks to @altsem for their encouragement to fork the gitu codebase for this purpose. Also to @stefanhaller for his work on the [OSC1717 spec](https://github.com/stefanhaller/diff-line-metadata-spec), which is what allows the TUI to understand delta's output.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8fc87bdd-ddca-4465-acd2-c1b8682b66f3

## What's Changed

Thanks to @pablospe,  @axsaucedo, and @nolith for several PRs and issue / review help.


* feat: Adds min-width parameter to enable toggling of side-by-side based on terminal width by @axsaucedo in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2084
* Allow CLI --side-by-side to disable a feature enabled in git config by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2319
* Bug fix: syntax-highlight deleted files where appropriate by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2322
* Side by side hunk by @nolith in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2304
* Correct tmux hyperlink support documentation by @cosgroveb in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2324
* Let --side-by-side keep the line-number formats from the user's features by @pablospe in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2321
* Keep the user's settings when using builtin features by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2326
* Update colibri theme and add colibri-colorblind by @pablospe in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2329
* Switch feature fixes by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2330
* Bug fix: make a style feature in a features list work by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2331
* Paint line numbers in the style of their line by @pablospe in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2332
* Emit the h record when the hunk header row is skipped by @kaygaaf in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2334
* Add a TUI based on a fork of gitu  by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2323
* delta-gitu v0.1.19 by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2339
* Fix the dead macOS download link in the installation docs by @farisbasha in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2342
* Fix tests failing when run in a terminal by @dandavison in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2343

## New Contributors
* @axsaucedo made their first contribution in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2084
* @nolith made their first contribution in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2304
* @cosgroveb made their first contribution in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2324
* @kaygaaf made their first contribution in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2334
* @farisbasha made their first contribution in https://github.com/dandavison/delta/pull/2342

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dandavison/delta/compare/0.20.1...0.21.1
